title: A pickup truck drives onto a youth soccer field in Wichita, Kansas; two are dead
dek: Police say two people died and more than ten were hurt. The driver is in custody and police have not said why it happened.
what: KWCH reports that at about 3:25 p.m. on Saturday 17 October a black pickup truck drove onto fields at the Stryker Sports Complex in Wichita during a youth soccer game. Police told KWCH two people died. KWCH counted 11 more people taken to hospital with traumatic injuries.

KWCH reports the driver, a woman, stayed at the scene and is in custody, that police said she had a valid licence, and that two children were in the truck. A police captain told KWCH there was no ongoing threat and that investigators had not yet said how or why the crash happened. Police were asking the public for video.
The New York Times and Fox News posted that two people, including a child, were killed. No names appear on this page. I left out posts that give personal details of the driver.
why: It happened at a children's game in the afternoon and police gave few details at first, so early posts filled the gap with guesses about the driver.
next: Police statements on the cause, whether charges are filed, and the condition of those still in hospital.

sources.label: KWCH: Police on the crash at Stryker Sports Complex
